data.exact_reserve_text:
This result has benefitted from a substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the continuing and increasingly favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account. The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been exceptionally light.

Within this profit, there was a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2012 year of account of GBP 12.7m before expenses and investment return. This arose largely from a reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 31/12/2014 was GBP 236.448m. Overall prior-year development at YE2015 was essentially flat (no material gross releases or strengthenings detected from the published gross claims development table), with management attributing beneficial movements in certain closed years to favourable claims development and light utilisation of IBNR. Some lines (notably third party liability) showed net strengthening at a net level, while property-related lines and accident & health showed net releases on a net basis; gross prior-year movement is not quantified in the notes and the gross claims development triangle indicates negligible movement for underwriting years older than two years.
raw_causal_phrases: benefitted from a substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the continuing and increasingly favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account.
The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been exceptionally light.
This arose largely from a reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure for the portfolio was stated in the notes or narrative. The gross claims development triangle was used as the primary source and indicates negligible movement for underwriting years <=2013, hence prior_year_development_gbp_m reported as 0.0. Several notes provide NET prior-year movements by class (net of reinsurance); these were used to infer direction by line but gross amounts by LOB are not disclosed and thus set to null. Some named losses reported in USD were left unconverted and their monetary impacts were not converted to GBP in the named_events entries.
